title: Fresh Integrated regional publication, held-claim recovery and continued reads
question: Can a fresh two-region Integrated demand preserve a fulfilled sibling, recover a held claim and retain a continued read on N47?
method: Reacquire stale host transport, run the real PDF and shared-host providers, hold one declared sentence claim before submission, release it, and verify exact resume, repeat and bounded native readback separately.
commands: uv run ci release reacquire-host --release RELEASE --runtime RUNTIME --database-oid 130661481 --target deployment --json
uv run ci query operations --demand DEMAND --project dmo04-n47-withheld-region-reacquired --limit 1 --max-bytes 262144 --json

inputs.role: Exact adaptation of the retained regional driver
Independent native read and held-task check

outputs.role: Stage runtime, regional recovery, exact readback and continuation observations

conclusion: The reacquired runtime published both regions with the real providers. Resume preserved the fulfilled sibling, advanced the held task to attempt two and fulfilled all 20 obligations. Unchanged repeat published zero receipts and installed query continuation retained its cut.
